# Share With Extensions

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Shares input with extensions.

## Syntax

~~~~text
shareEXT(file: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
shareEXT(file: ShortcutInput)
~~~~
